business_problem: Vivriti Capital needed to replace a legacy architecture consisting of Amazon Redshift, open source Spark, Airflow and custom orchestration to eliminate pipeline failures, compliance risks and manual engineering interventions across its API-driven lending business.
solution_summary: Vivriti Capital built its Databricks implementation around Databricks SQL, Databricks Genie, Redshift, Airflow. Vivriti Capital needed to replace a legacy architecture consisting of Amazon Redshift, open source Spark, Airflow and custom orchestration to eliminate pipeline failures, compliance risks and manual engineering interventions across its API-driven lending business. Databricks SQL serves governed analytics, dashboards, and ad hoc queries for business users and operational teams. Databricks Genie lets business users ask natural-language questions over curated data. Redshift represents a legacy warehouse replaced or simplified by the new platform. Airflow represents legacy orchestration simplified by Databricks-native workflows. The solution also connects to Redshift, Airflow, API, so teams can work from a shared governed environment instead of disconnected tools.
